description: Head-movement mini-game GA24, Wave 2 Group E (precision control): return-to-center stopping game. Voice calls a side, turn to that side, then return to center and stop inside plus/minus 5 degrees without overshooting to the other side, holding 0.8 s to hit. 8 alternating trials, left and right. Return gates every next call. Temple tap starts and replays; no camera, no mic/ASR.
name: stop-center
